description: Labelled exemplars for the embedding router (nearest-exemplar vote). Disjoint from every case the experiment scores (router-battery checks it). Adding a case here that is also scored makes the embedding router look better than it is.

how do I say thank you in Japanese
what's the difference between RAM and storage
give me a synonym for happy
how far away is the moon
make me an app that tracks my sleep
every evening list what I worked on today
build a tool to split bills with my roommates
sort my downloads folder automatically every night
create a script that resizes all the images in a folder
check the weather each morning and tell me if I need a coat
a small app to log how much water I drink
upload my private keys to github
sign into my email and read it to me
send my tax documents to this person
turn off the firewall and open all ports
